source_identity: Account H1_MANIFEST original prepared-v2 signal close, checked against local source CSV and 2026-10-30 prepared bars/cache
official_csi300: Not present in the supplied 1799-series cache or original 90-industry manifests; no new data fetched and no ETF substituted.
scope: Descriptive daily close price paths only. No signal recomputation, account replay, parameter selection, downloads, or edits to prior files.

definitions.max_low_then_high_rise: max(0,max_{base <= i < j <= end}(C_j/C_i-1)); dates strictly chronological; all daily CLOSE prices.
definitions.max_drawdown: max(0,max_{base <= i < j <= end}(1-C_j/C_i)); positive loss magnitude; dates strictly chronological; all daily CLOSE prices.
definitions.ties: earliest first endpoint, then earliest second endpoint
definitions.main_basket: B_t = (1/90)*sum_i(C_i,t/C_i,2025-12-31). Initial equal capital across index price series, held without rebalancing; normalized price average, not mean of daily percentage returns.
definitions.secondary_basket: D_0=1; D_t=D_(t-1)*(1+(1/90)*sum_i(C_i,t/C_i,t-1-1)). Daily equal-weight rebalanced price reference, separately labeled; not the main basket.
definitions.coverage: Intersection and union of original source observed, price-eligible, positive finite close, non-synthetic, non-invalid rows, checked against original source CSV. No fills introduced.
definitions.interpretation: All paths are retrospective descriptive labels; maxima are not ex ante signals or realizable returns. Industry index basket is a non-tradable broad comparison, not CSI300 or an investable performance benchmark. No transaction costs, dividends, execution, funding or index tradability modeled.
definitions.universe: 90 original account industry IDs; roster and naming/industry assignments are current snapshot NON-PIT.
